====================================================
OFFICIAL BUSINESS DESCRIPTION
====================================================

The Sulfab Law Office is a full-service law firm located in San Francisco, California, providing legal representation to individuals, families, entrepreneurs, startups, and businesses throughout California and across the United States.

The firm focuses on four primary practice areas:

• Immigration Law
• Intellectual Property Law
• Personal Injury Law
• Workers' Compensation

Sulfab Law combines strategic legal representation, transparent communication, and personalized legal solutions to help clients navigate complex legal matters.

The firm's philosophy is centered on integrity, responsiveness, practical legal guidance, and achieving favorable outcomes for every client.

====================================================
PRIMARY PRACTICE AREAS
====================================================

IMMIGRATION LAW

Sulfab Law provides comprehensive immigration representation for individuals, families, investors, professionals, and businesses.

Services include:

• Family-Based Immigration
• Marriage Green Cards

• Asylum

• Humanitarian Relief
• Federal Immigration Litigation

• Employment-Based Immigration
